maya: Quick heads-up 1: releasing a small community package: reference-arch-samples v0.1.0 :tada:

maya: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reference-arch-samples/releases/tag/v0.1.0

maya: What's included:
- streaming-chat: websocket front-end + prefix caching example
- batch-embeddings-pipeline: S3 -> batch job -> vectorstore pattern
- private-vpc-deploy: terraform + example KMS wiring (demo only)

samira: congrats! who owns private-vpc-deploy support?

maya: @samira will triage issues for the VPC sample, @kevin for infra review.

kevin: note: demo KMS key is for examples only; don't copy to prod. I added a README warning (tiny PR).

liam: I've added nightly smoke tests and linting CI for the examples. Tag me on flaky failures.

maya: README snippet for hosted API usage (please include in docs):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood/fast-1\",\"input\":\"Summarize the following...\"}'
```

samira: added a small eval prompt set to the streaming-chat sample for latency sanity checks.

ci-bot: CI: nightly pipeline started for reference-arch-samples (run id: 98401) :gear:

ops-bot: Release created on GitHub; Docker image pushed as redwood/reference-arch:v0.1.0

maya: We'll host maintainer office hours tomorrow 10am PT in #devex for a quick walkthrough and contributor onboarding. Reply if you want to be added to the maintainers table.

kevin: licensing ok (Apache-2.0).

samira: I'll draft a short troubleshooting FAQ in #support after a few issues arrive.

maya: Thanks team 1 :shipit:
